builder_admin_set_at_deploy.meaning: BuilderWallet was deployed by BuilderFactory owner with a legitimate builderAdmin set atomically after deployment
builder_admin_set_at_deploy.checkpoint: after deployment, before any admin rotation

fees_accumulated_in_wallet.meaning: Protocol fees have accumulated in the BuilderWallet over time as a fee recipient

admin_change_call.meaning: a call that changes the BuilderWallet admin (init) is executed

caller_is_current_admin.meaning: the caller of the admin-changing call is the current builderAdmin

all_accumulated_fees_stolen.meaning: all accumulated builder fees in the BuilderWallet are transferred out to an attacker with no preconditions required

claims.scope: Direct theft of all accumulated builder fees with no preconditions required.

preconditions.text: BuilderFactory owner deploys a BuilderWallet with a legitimate builderAdmin set atomically after deployment.; Protocol fees accumulate in the BuilderWallet over time as it is used as a fee recipient.
preconditions.derivation: Program conjunction of selected report preconditions.

safety.text: If admin rotation is a desired feature, calls that change the admin must be restricted to the current admin.
safety.derivation: Program synthesis from the selected intent and logical pattern.

effects.text: Direct theft of all accumulated builder fees with no preconditions required.
effects.derivation: Program-generated direct negation witness for the selected safety pattern.

effect_coverage.reason: Program-generated exact coverage for selected direct impact.

assumptions: The admin-changing call is init() as described in relation_context; the intent's 'calls that change the admin' is represented by admin_change_call.

limitations: The intent is conditional ('if admin rotation is a desired feature'); the guard is encoded as the required authorization for any admin-changing call.
Theft outcome is represented as a grounded Boolean because the report gives no numeric fee amount.
